# Clearly Online

> Independent web design studio near Sevenoaks, Kent. Clearly Online builds clear websites for local trades and small businesses, with practical local SEO, hosting and ongoing care.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/): The studio, services, prices and how to enquire.
- [Website design](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/web-design.html): Website builds, redesigns, quote forms and booking integrations.
- [Pricing](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/pricing.html): Guide package prices, setup fees, 12-month managed commitment, exclusions and cost comparison.
- [About Clearly Online](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/about.html): The studio's mission and approach.
- [Contact](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/contact.html): Public email address and an optional email draft tool.

## Who the websites are for

- [Trades and home services](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/websites-for-trades.html): Service areas, job examples and useful quote requests.
- [Appointment-led businesses](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/websites-for-appointments.html): Service clarity, booking tools and customer questions.
- [Local professional services](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/websites-for-professionals.html): Explaining complex work, trust and introductory enquiries.

## Other services

- [Local SEO](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/local-seo.html): Search foundations and optional ongoing work.
- [Website care](https://clearlyonline.co.uk/website-care.html): Hosting, maintenance and support.

## Key facts

- The studio serves businesses near Sevenoaks and across Kent; projects can be reviewed remotely.
- Website build guide prices are Starter £795, Business £1,495, and Growth from £2,495.
- Managed website guide prices are Starter £99/month with £195 setup, Business £159/month with £295 setup, and Growth from £239/month with £395 setup. The initial managed term is 12 months from launch.
- The quote determines final scope, tax treatment, third-party costs and contractual terms.
- No customer ratings, awards, quantified results or search ranking guarantees are claimed.
- Public contact: clearlyonlineuk@gmail.com. The website prepares an email draft; sending happens in the visitor's email app.
